svg.title: Causal-Based Dhamma Practice Workflow for Dasuttara Sutta

g.text: Causal-Based Dhamma Practice Workflow for Dasuttara Sutta
Hear the True Dhamma (e.g., from people of integrity)
Live with Heedfulness (as root of skillful qualities)
"What is the cause, what is the reason, why...?"
Comprehend Dhammas: Stress, Origination, Cessation, Path
Discern Skillful & Unskillful Qualities and Their Roots (e.g., Greed, Aversion, Delusion as causes of actions)
Understand Dependent Co-arising (how phenomena "come into play")
Identify Sectarian Views that lead to "inaction" or "wrong views"
"__ should be developed / made to arise / pursued"
Develop Skillful Qualities (e.g., Virtue, Concentration, Discernment, Persistence, Mindfulness)
Develop the Noble Eightfold Path ("the way leading to the cessation of _")
Develop the Four Establishings of Mindfulness
Practice Jhāna & Internal Tranquility of Awareness
Practice Consistently in Line with the Dhamma
Attain Gnosis / Direct Knowledge of Phenomena (knowing & seeing "as they have come to be")
"From the cessation of _ comes the cessation of _"
